Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: The Company's business was dependent on the commencement of mining operation by its holding company. However, during the F.Y. 2014-15, the Hon'ble Supreme Court had passed an order cancelling coal block allocations of various companies including the holding company. Considering the aforesaid cancellation, the Company is looking for another business project. In view of no business operations, the Company has incurred loss on account of administrative and other expenses, current liabilities are more than current assets as at current & previous year end and its net worth has also become negative. Further, depreciable fixed assets have been fully depreciated in the previous year considering no significant recoverable value. The Company has received commitment from holding company for infusing the funds as and when required for any working capital requirements or any other shortfall that may arise due to the lack of operations in the Company. Considering the same, accounts are prepared on going concern.

Emphasis on going concern - The Company has incurred loss on account of administrative and other expenses, current liabilities are more than current assets as at current & previous year end and its net worth has also become negative by Rs. 150.03 lakhs as on 31st March, 2026.
